subject.title: Cron jobs stall during AI model calls (model_call:stream_progress never completes)

question: Should this bundled issue stay open as the tracker for the remaining cron wake result-contract gap, or should maintainers split that gap into a focused issue and close this bundle after linking the fixed and tracked pieces?
rationale: The headline stream stall is fixed on current main, and the main-session systemEvent overlap has a newer focused open tracker, but the remaining wake-now ok:true versus later failure behavior is an API contract choice that current source does not settle.

options.title: Split the wake contract gap
options.body: File or designate a focused tracker for cron.wake result semantics, link the fixed run-lifecycle stack and main-session cron tracker, then close this bundle once the handoff is explicit.

options.title: Keep this issue scoped to wake-now
options.body: Retitle or clarify this issue so it tracks only the remaining cron.wake ok:true versus downstream failure behavior.

options.title: Treat wake as enqueue-only
options.body: Document that cron.wake success only means enqueue/request accepted, and close the remaining expectation as unsupported after maintainers accept that product contract.

recommendation.title: Split the wake contract gap
recommendation.body: File or designate a focused tracker for cron.wake result semantics, link the fixed run-lifecycle stack and main-session cron tracker, then close this bundle once the handoff is explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus posted the latest status comment that separated the fixed headline stall from the remaining wake contract gap.
